operationContexts.label: Prepare Cs-oleate solution
operationContexts.description: Combine 1.2 g Cs2CO3, 3.75 mL OA and 45 mL ODE in a 100 mL three-neck flask. Hold under vacuum for 1 h at 120 °C, then heat under N2 to 150 °C until Cs2CO3 reacts with OA. Preheat stock to 100 °C before injection because it precipitates at room temperature.

environment.value: Vacuum during initial hold; N2 during heating to 150 °C

endpoint.value: Until all Cs2CO3 reacts with OA; reaction time not stated

operationContexts.label: Prepare hot CuCl mixture
operationContexts.description: Load 10 mL ODE and 0.45 mmol CuCl into a 25 mL three-neck flask and dry under vacuum for 1 h at 120 °C. At 120 °C under N2 add 1 mL dried oleylamine and 1 mL dried OA; after complete CuCl dissolution, raise to 160 °C.

environment.value: Vacuum during drying; N2 after ligand addition

general_background.title: Amine coordination
general_background.summary: An amine nitrogen can donate electron density to suitable solution species or surface sites. Donation from the nitrogen lone pair and competition with other ligands can change precursor speciation and surface association.
